definition: A defined sequence of steps, tools and decisions that an AI system executes to complete a larger goal.
details: A workflow chains models with data sources, tools and human-approval gates. In agentic workflows the model chooses the next step dynamically, while deterministic workflows run a fixed script — the two ends of the automation spectrum.
story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. The machine stops just answering one question and starts getting a job done, step by step, checking its work along the way. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Workflows.
